correctness.rationale: Exact independent-set enumeration finds 392 faces and an explicit 191-pair acyclic Morse matching leaving one vertex and nine 3-cells; all 1200 oriented incidences pass a topological sort. Thus the rational homology is concentrated in degree 3. Two independent fixed-face and vertex-orbit Lefschetz algorithms agree with the proposed full character for all 1920 automorphisms, and exact Fourier projectors recover the four invariant plus five nontrivial translation-character dimensions. The induced summand has exactly the same character by elementary coset tracing; finite-group semisimplicity proves the rational module isomorphism. No experimental extrapolation is needed.

value.rationale: The Clebsch/folded-five-cube graph has maximal symmetry 2^4:S5 and a known rank-nine third homology, but the symmetry action is not determined by rank or a nonequivariant wedge. The result gives the full 1920-element equivariant invariant as a transparent induced-representation decomposition, identifies a four-dimensional translation-fixed subspace and proves zero full-group invariants. Those exact facts enable symmetry-quotient and equivariant calculations and are motivated by this canonical highly symmetric graph rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
